method.method_draft: First describe the image: the curve represents number of atoms versus kinetic energy, with a single maximum at low kinetic energy and a long decreasing tail to high kinetic energy; labels A through D mark increasing kinetic energies. From the text, treat this as Ne atoms at a fixed temperature, so the Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distribution applies. Locate the most probable energy at the curve maximum, then use the Maxwell-Boltzmann fact that the average kinetic energy is larger than the most probable energy. Select the label just to the right of the peak/main maximum rather than the far-tail label, which is C.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中横轴标为 Kinetic energy，纵轴标为 Number of Ne atoms。曲线从接近零动能处快速上升，在较低动能区域达到单一峰值，然后向较高动能方向缓慢下降，形成长尾。字母 A、B、C、D 沿横轴从左到右标出，其中 C 位于峰值附近稍偏右的位置，D 更靠右在尾部区域。
推理：这是 500 K 下大量 Ne 原子的动能分布，符合 Maxwell-Boltzmann 分布。曲线峰值对应最概然动能，而平均动能由于高能长尾的影响会大于最概然动能。因此平均动能应位于峰值右侧，但不应在很远的尾部。图中最符合这一位置的标记是 C。
